scope: Mac M1 Max; UE Development desktop Metal SM5 renderer; visible 1440x810 viewport; explicit 30 FPS cap. These are Mac measurements, not iPhone heat or utilization evidence.
limitations: Each profile samples 600 frames after 30 warmups. One delayed instrumented GPU frame is inside each sample window.
Foreground diagnostics report 0 and 600 background samples while Slate frame policy reports menu or gameplay. This is not a sustained foreground benchmark.
Raw engine timings can contain waits; GPU completions are asynchronous. Percent columns in GPU profiles are fractions of that frame, not hardware utilization.
Apple on-GPU wall time is a per-process presented-frame timing, not GPU occupancy or utilization. Live interval records include startup; do not average all records as a warmed benchmark.
The translucent-lighting-volume pass is absent after disabling it. Aggregate battle GPU means of 11.553 and 11.470 ms are too close to establish an overall gain.
mac-menu-after/scene.png captured startup before map load and is excluded from visual evidence.
